On Jun 21, 2012, at 7:43 AM, Marie-Joseph Experton wrote:

At present, there are twin bed in the Chinese bedroom, which (I understand) Mr. Epstein wants to be replaced
by or turned into a king sized bed.
Because of the existing two bed heads covered with a special material matching with the rest of the room
including curtains, the proposal from TAPISSIER SEIGNEUR is to undo partially the two bed heads
("decouverture partielle"), assemble them ("assemblage des deux tiles de lit") and redo the cover to make it
one ("assemblage des deux rites de litfacon couvertum). The base of the twin beds will be assembled and one
single piece over the mattresses ("fournitztre d'un surmatelas TRECA Rivoli en 200 x 190 ent") will turn the
whole into one single king sized bed (200x190cm).
The overall price VAT included amounts to 4,951.44 E.
Please advise.
Best regards.
Marie-Joseph Experton
